data.name: All-You-Can-Eat – Restaurant-Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to pure restaurant chaos!

In All-You-Can-Eat Restaurant Simulator, up to four players work together to run a hectic all-you-can-eat restaurant. Cook dishes, serve hungry guests, and keep the operation running while chaos constantly unfolds.

Players can freely switch between tasks such as cooking, serving, cleaning, and managing the restaurant floor. Unexpected events, impatient customers, and messy situations will test communication, timing, and teamwork. Since every player can perform all actions, you'll need to coordinate instantly to see who jumps in where.

Burnt food, spilled dishes, and unhappy guests can quickly spiral into disaster if the team is not well coordinated. Only by working together, reacting quickly, and keeping a cool head can the restaurant survive each shift.

All-You-Can-Eat Restaurant Simulator is a cooperative party game with a stylized low-poly art style, designed for fun, chaos, and shared laughter. Perfect for short, intense sessions with friends.

  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 / AMD Radeon R7 370 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Storage: 5 GB available space
